summary: Discusses use cases and deployment scenarios for Open Pluggable Edge Services (OPES), which are services applied to requests or responses at intermediaries. It examines the kinds of things such services could do. It is informational.

eli5.summary: Imagine a helper standing on the road between you and a website who can fix or translate things going by. This lists situations where that is useful.

questions: open pluggable edge services use cases
